"Task specifications (listed alphabetically; implement only the requested file):
batch_translate.py - translates a list of strings while preserving order
localized_audio_preview.py - Generate spoken previews of translated copy
quality_summary.py - Summarize translation quality issues
translate_dictionary_values.py - translates dictionary values while preserving keys
translate_markup.py - translates HTML or markup while preserving tags
translate_text.py - translates a single text string between languages
translation_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for General Text Translation
translation_memory_embedding.py - Embed translated segments for translation-memory search
translation_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for General Text Translation
unsafe_copy_check.py - Check localized copy for unsafe content

Create translate_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: translates a single text string between languages.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: translate_text.py
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_BASE = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", "https://api.openai.com/v1")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")
+
+
+def translate_text(text: str, source_language: str, target_language: str, glossary: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        raise TypeError("text must be a string")
+    if not text:
+        return ""
+    if not source_language or not target_language:
+        raise ValueError("source_language and target_language are required")
+
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    glossary_lines = ""
+    if glossary:
+        glossary_lines = "\n".join(f"{k} => {v}" for k, v in glossary.items())
+
+    prompt = (
+        f"Translate the following text from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
+        f"Preserve meaning, tone, numbers, and formatting. Return only the translated text."
+    )
+    if glossary_lines:
+        prompt += f"\nUse this glossary when appropriate:\n{glossary_lines}"
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{OPENAI_API_BASE.rstrip('/')}/responses",
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": OPENAI_TRANSLATION_MODEL,
+            "input": [
+                {
+                    "role": "system",
+                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "You are a professional translation engine."}],
+                },
+                {
+                    "role": "user",
+                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": f"{prompt}\n\n{text}"}],
+                },
+            ],
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+
+    output = data.get("output", [])
+    for item in output:
+        if item.get("type") == "message":
+            for content in item.get("content", []):
+                if content.get("type") == "output_text" and content.get("text"):
+                    return content["text"].strip()
+
+    raise RuntimeError("No translation returned by OpenAI Responses API")
*** End Patch
